SD63-CP01.name: Grandwalkers Gallet & Varte
SD63-CP01.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (War Dragon/Clever Machine/Proximate/Astroblazer & Cost 3 or more)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same name as this Nexus, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Field] [LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
You can destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. Or, you can put a core from the Void to any of your Red-White dual color Grandwalker Nexus. This [Grand Field] doesn't stack.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Return an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit to the Hand. Or, return a "Lord" family card from the Trash to your Hand.

SD63-TCP02.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars XXI The World
SD63-TCP02.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Reborn)
During this turn, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Brave/Nexus effects.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] Flash - (When Attacks)
Once per turn, if you have five or less counters, by putting two cores from your Counter Area to this Spirit, this Spirit refreshes, and during this turn, this Spirit gains two different colored symbols from among Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

SD63-TCP01.name: The SovereignMachineDragon Dynasty-Dragon
SD63-TCP01.effect:
[Brave Symbol +1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit. Also, if it's reborn by reducing the opposing Life, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By destroying a Nexus you or the opponent controls, this Spirit refreshes. The effects of the Nexus destroyed by this effect can't activate.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
If you have seven or more Nexus cards in your Trash, send two opposing Lives to the Reserve.

SD63-TCP01-A730.name: The TowerDeityMachineSoldier Solidus-Golem
SD63-TCP01-A730.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When blocked, discard twelve cards from the opposing decktop. If not blocked, when you reduce the opposing Life, discard seven cards from the opposing decktop, and the opponent can't activate Burst effects with the condition: [Burst: con] (After your Life is reduced).

[LV2][LV3] [Rebirth5]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, or the opposing Life is reduced during this Spirit's battle, if there is any card with Mirage effects in your Trash, you can flip this Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A749.name: World Mirage
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A749.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3]
[During Set] (Start of Opposing Attack Step)
By discarding a "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" family card from your Hand, during this turn, one of the (When Attacks) effects of an opposing Spirit can't activate.

[During Set] [Rebirth5]
When the opponent Rebirths, after that effect resolves, you can flip this Mirage onto the Field by putting any number of cores from your Field/Reserve onto it.

[LV1]
This Nexus’s symbol is also treated as Red/Purple/Green/Yellow/Blue. Also, this Nexus is unaffected by your effects, other than this Nexus’s own effects.

SD63-003.name: The ShiningHeavenCleverMachine-FivePledgeLord Amatsu-Hikone
SD63-003.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core][Red Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
Your attacking non-braved "Avatar" & "Lord" family Spirit gains an extra White symbol.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void each to this Spirit and a "Vassal"/"War Dragon" family Spirit you control.

SD63-004.name: The ShiningHeavenCleverMachine-FivePledgeLord Kumano-Kusubi
SD63-004.effect:
When this set card is discarded by the opponent, you can activate it, ignoring the Burst condition.

[Burst: s] (After an opposing Spirit/Nexus's (When Summoned/Deployed) effect resolves)
Return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the deckbottom, and when returned, put a core from the Void to your Reserve. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the Hand.

SD63-X01.name: The ShiningHeavenDragonNoble Dynasty-Dragon
SD63-X01.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Red Core][White Core])]
[During Set]
Once per turn, when your "Lord" family Spirit [Advent]/Reborn, you can draw two cards. Then, during this turn, while your "Avatar" & "Lord" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
By sending two cores from your Red-White Dual color Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void, destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Nexus/Grandwalker Nexus.

SD63-001.name: The ShiningHeavenMusha Ignite-Dragon
SD63-001.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 4 ([Red Core][Red Core][White Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
Your attacking non-braved "Avatar" & "Lord" family Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.

[LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
If you have any card set, draw a card. This effect doesn't stack.

SD63-TX01.name: The ShiningHeavenRideEmperor Dragonic-Arthur
SD63-TX01.effect:
[+1]

[Unleash: 1] [LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Reborn/Attacks)
During this turn, an opposing Spirit/Nexus can't activate its effects, and destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirits', or an opposing Nexus. By sending a core from your Red-White dual color Grandwalker Nexus to this Spirit, this effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

[LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
If the opponent doesn't control any Spirit, send two opposing Lives to the Reserve.

SD63-002.name: The ShiningHeavenSupremeDragon Explode-Dragon
SD63-002.effect:
Flash - [Advent: War Dragon/Clever Machine & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When opposing Spirits have left the Field due to your Red/White “Lord” family Spirits, you can send an opposing Life to the Reserve. This effect can only be used once per turn.

SD63-TX01-A13623.name: The WingDeityCleverMachine Grand-Woden-Zwei
SD63-TX01-A13623.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Burst to the deckbottom. Also, during this turn, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Ultimate effects.

[LV2][LV3] [Rebirth5]
When this Spirit attacks/blocks, if you control any Red-White Dual color Grandwalker Nexus, you can flip this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.
